name: scrna-disease-drug-discovery
description: Use for end-to-end disease-focused scRNA-seq analysis that integrates cell states, differential expression, and human genetic evidence to prioritize therapeutic targets.
default_message: Run an end-to-end scRNA-seq disease drug discovery analysis on GSE195452 systemic sclerosis skin biopsies with genetic evidence integration to identify and prioritize therapeutic targets. Perform differential expression, pathway analysis, ligand-receptor interactions, genetic target evidence from Open Targets and GeneBass, and multi-omics target prioritization. Generate a PDF report with intro, methods, results, conclusions and figures.
